items.description: Analyze repository modules, helper scripts, saved artifacts, and data flow for the Hadamard-668 research pipeline.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/repo_map.md` listing `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `results/literature/`, `results/swarm/`, and `results/verification/`; explain how literature, swarm, verification, and concept-tree artifacts connect; note the current absence of `research_rubric.json` history, missing `results/verification/*` outputs, and the current `_run_sub_agent` versus `evolve()` mismatch in `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`.
items.notes: Created `results/repo_map.md` with the actual repo data flow, documented the empty `results/verification/` state and the single-commit rubric history, repaired the local `evolve()` -> `_run_sub_agent()` argument mismatch in the ignored helper, and launched the mandatory `python3 .archivara/concept_evolve.py evolve ...` run before closing the item.

items.description: Write a repo-grounded problem statement for exact real Hadamard order 668 and the cellular-automata direction.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/problem_statement.md` stating that the target is an exact real Hadamard matrix of order `668`, that the current frontier anchor is the `64`-modular order-668 object rather than an exact solution, that `cellar automata` is treated as `cellular automata` unless later defined otherwise, and that the narrow claim is CA as a seeded repair dynamic rather than a generic Hadamard-construction claim.
items.notes: Created `results/problem_statement.md` and fixed the problem scope to exact real order 668, the 2025 `64`-modular object as frontier seed rather than solution, `cellar automata` interpreted as `cellular automata`, and CA framed only as a seeded repair dynamic under matched controls.

items.description: Extend the literature snapshot with web search, Semantic Scholar, and code-repository search instead of starting from zero.
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` by preserving its existing keys and adding at least 10 genuinely relevant new papers plus at least 3 relevant code repositories or solver implementations; record new queries in `results/literature/semantic_scholar_manifest.json`; add `results/literature/code_watchlist.md` summarizing the code artifacts and state-of-the-art approaches found by web search.
items.notes: Updated `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` while preserving its original keys and added a targeted layer with 13 relevant papers plus 4 code artifacts; `results/literature/code_watchlist.md` now separates exact-search repos from CA/NCA reference code; the Semantic Scholar manifest records the new targeted title queries used to build the set.

items.description: Create and maintain `sources.bib` for all consulted literature used by the run.
items.acceptance_criteria: `sources.bib` exists in the repo root with at least 10 relevant BibTeX entries, including `A 64-Modular Hadamard Matrix of Order 668 (2025)`, `Cellular Automata Applications in Shortest Path Problem (2017)`, `Learning Automata-Based Solutions to the Single Elevator Problem (2019)`, and at least two Hadamard-search baseline papers; every paper cited in Phase 1 notes appears in `sources.bib`.
items.notes: Created `sources.bib` with 17 entries, including the manual 2025 frontier paper and helper-generated BibTeX for the named watchlist papers, modular Hadamard background papers, annealing/QAOA Hadamard-search baselines, SAT+CAS baselines, and CA-adjacent comparator papers.

items.description: Use `explorer`, `research_director`, and `integrator` to align the concept tree and prior-art gap file with the director swarm before implementation.
items.acceptance_criteria: After reading `results/swarm/hypotheses.json` and `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`, create `results/swarm/selection_note.md` that justifies `H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m` as the initial branch or explicitly explains a deviation; populate `results/concept_evolve/tree/` with at least 10 concept folders plus `index.json` and `walk_paths.json` using `.archivara/concept_evolve.py` or a documented fallback if the helper still needs repair; update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with filled differentiation notes for `Cellular Automata Applications in Shortest Path Problem (2017)`, `Learning Automata-Based Solutions to the Single Elevator Problem (2019)`, `On the possibility of oscillating in the Ebola virus dynamics and investigating the effect of the lifetime of T lymphocytes (2022)`, `Engineering Societies in the Agents World (2000)`, and `A 64-Modular Hadamard Matrix of Order 668 (2025)`.
items.notes: Used `explorer`, `research_director`, and `integrator` to align the generated 11-node concept tree with the saved swarm plan; created `results/swarm/selection_note.md`, `results/swarm/director_reassessment.md`, `results/swarm/explorer_alignment_note.md`, and `results/concept_evolve/concept_delta.md`; updated `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with filled differentiation notes for the named watchlist papers and the 2025 frontier paper.

items.description: Acquire the actual 64-modular order-668 frontier seed or generating quadruple and canonicalize it.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/frontier/order_668_64m/seed_manifest.json` with source provenance, raw artifact location, canonicalized representative, symmetry operations applied, and checksum; if the seed cannot be obtained, create `results/frontier/order_668_64m/blocker.md` with the exact missing inputs and stop Phase 3 execution.
items.notes: Recovered the compact frontier seed from the 2025 paper, added `hadamard_ca/seed.py` plus `scripts/export_frontier_seed.py`, and generated `results/frontier/order_668_64m/seed_manifest.json`, `seed_sequences.json`, and `source_excerpt.txt`. The manifest records source provenance, the raw paper URL and SHA256, the canonical q/s representative, identity symmetry choice, and validation against the published 13 exceptional coefficients and 64-modular Gram condition.

items.description: Build a shared exactness and defect evaluation harness for CA and non-CA methods.
items.acceptance_criteria: One callable harness computes exact-hit flag, off-diagonal Gram defect support size, max defect magnitude, defect histogram, wall-clock time, objective evaluations, restart statistics, and symmetry-canonicalized fingerprints from the same interface for every method; the harness is validated on at least 2 smaller solved Hadamard controls.
items.notes: Added `hadamard_ca/harness.py` and `hadamard_ca/controls.py` plus `scripts/validate_harness.py`. The shared `run_harness(...)` interface now computes exact-hit, correlation and full Gram defect support, max defect magnitude, defect histogram, wall-clock time, objective evaluations, restart statistics, and a symmetry-canonicalized fingerprint; `results/controls/exact_controls.json`, `results/verification/harness_validation.md`, and `results/verification/harness_interface.md` validate it on exact controls of lengths 5 and 7.

items.description: Implement seed-matched non-CA baselines in the same coordinate system as the chosen CA representation.
items.acceptance_criteria: `greedy`, `tabu`, `simulated annealing`, and one same-coordinate non-CA local-search control run from identical seeds, identical evaluation budgets, and identical exactness checks; configurations and launch commands for all four baselines are stored under `results/baselines/`.
items.notes: Added `hadamard_ca/search.py` plus `scripts/run_baseline.py`, stored matched pilot configs and exact launch commands under `results/baselines/`, and ran the four baselines from the same deterministic non-exact length-7 q/s seed. `results/baselines/smoke_summary.md` shows that `greedy`, `tabu`, `simulated_annealing`, and `stochastic_hillclimb` all use the same exactness harness and reach exactness under the shared budget/restart settings, with simulated annealing converging to an alternate exact fingerprint.

items.description: Use `benchmark_auditor`, `explorer`, and `integrator` to audit the baseline harness before frontier runs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/benchmark_spec.md` confirming seed matching, equal-budget accounting, representation control, symmetry handling, restart policy, and exact-hit reporting; the auditor must explicitly approve or reject the setup before Phase 3 experiments proceed.
items.notes: Created `results/verification/benchmark_spec.md` as the explicit benchmark contract for the four non-CA baselines. The spec confirms shared seed files, q/s representation control, equal-budget accounting, restart parity, canonical-fingerprint reporting, and exact-hit handling, and it explicitly approves the setup for Phase 3 work and the first order-668 kill-test plan while keeping broad sweeps gated on `item_010` and `item_016`.

items.description: Define the baseline gate metrics and stop rules for the seeded order-668 program.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/benchmark_gate.md` stating that exact-hit rate is the primary gate, defect-count-only improvements do not count as success, and `H1` is stopped if defect support plateaus, diffuses, or loses advantage to matched baselines on the canonical seed.
items.notes: Created `results/verification/benchmark_gate.md` with the seeded order-668 decision contract: exact-hit rate is the primary gate, defect-count-only improvements are explicitly non-successes, and `H1` stops if late-checkpoint defect support plateaus, diffuses, or loses lexicographic tuple advantage to the matched non-CA baselines on the canonical seed.

items.description: Implement the champion `H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m` branch as a compressed defect-repair cellular automaton.
items.acceptance_criteria: Document and code one compressed defect representation whose state is not the raw `668 x 668` sign lattice; define local update rules, neighborhood, conserved quantities, and seed loading; store a branch brief under `results/branches/H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m.md`.
items.notes: Implemented the executable H1 branch in `hadamard_ca/h1_ca.py` plus `scripts/run_h1_ca.py`, using a sparse lag-syndrome field coupled to a two-channel q/s packet lattice rather than a raw `668 x 668` sign grid. `results/branches/H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m.md` documents the update rule, neighborhoods, conserved quantities, and seed loading; smoke checks show exact repair on the shared length-7 control and clean execution on the canonical order-668 seed.

items.description: Use `hypothesis_scout`, `falsifier`, and `integrator` to stress-test H1 before broad sweeps.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/branches/H1_precheck.md` with at least 3 predicted failure modes, 3 parameter axes worth exploring, 1 minimal kill test, and 1 explicit anti-pattern describing how H1 would collapse into generic local search.
items.notes: Created `results/branches/H1_precheck.md` with six H1-specific failure modes, four parameter axes, a minimal matched frontier kill test, and an explicit collapse anti-pattern. The precheck now uses the saved H1 smoke artifacts plus `results/concept_evolve/probe_result.json`, which sharpens the diagnosis by indicating that the current single-bit q/s packet basis is already frozen on the canonical seed.

items.description: Open the backup `H2_lag_space_ca_167` branch only behind a locality-failure gate.
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/branches/H2_gate.md` exists and states that H2 activates only if H1 fails for principled locality reasons rather than weak implementation; the gate must include a family-leakage audit against Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, and block-circulant structure.
items.notes: Created `results/branches/H2_gate.md` and kept H2 closed by default. The gate now says H2 opens only after a matched H1 frontier failure that looks representation-level and locality-driven, not like weak implementation, and it includes an explicit family-leakage audit against Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, and block-circulant collapse.

items.description: Keep `H3_spacetime_row_emission_ca` as reserve unless earlier branches fail for representation reasons.
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/branches/H3_gate.md` exists and limits H3 to a tight exploratory budget, forbids wide rule sweeps, and requires an explicit overlap check against direct CA-construction literature before any substantial build-out.
items.notes: Created `results/branches/H3_gate.md` and kept H3 closed by default. The gate limits H3 to a very tight exploratory budget, forbids wide rule or seed sweeps, and requires an explicit overlap check against direct CA-construction literature before any substantial build-out.

items.description: Use `novelty_checker`, `citation_auditor`, and `integrator` to run an explicit novelty precheck against named prior art before Phase 4 experiments.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/novelty_precheck.md` comparing active branches against `Cellular Automata Applications in Shortest Path Problem (2017)`, `Learning Automata-Based Solutions to the Single Elevator Problem (2019)`, `On the possibility of oscillating in the Ebola virus dynamics and investigating the effect of the lifetime of T lymphocytes (2022)`, `Engineering Societies in the Agents World (2000)`, and `A 64-Modular Hadamard Matrix of Order 668 (2025)`; append corresponding evidence links to `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`.
items.notes: Created `results/verification/novelty_precheck.md` and appended new evidence links to the named-paper entries in `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md`. The novelty-checker specialist note landed as `results/verification/novelty_checker_note.md`; the final precheck keeps the claim narrow and concludes that H1 is only conditionally differentiated, while H2 and H3 remain gated rather than active contributions.

items.description: Run matched experiments on smaller solved controls before the frontier seed.
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute all active methods on at least 2 smaller solved controls using identical restart counts and evaluation budgets; save configurations and raw logs under `results/experiments/controls/`; report exact-hit rate, median defect reduction, and variance.
items.notes: Ran `H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m`, `greedy`, `tabu`, `simulated_annealing`, and `stochastic_hillclimb` on deterministic `control_n5_q0` and `control_n7_q0` seeds with shared budget `80`, restart count `3`, and RNG seed `17`. Saved configs, seeds, raw outputs, and aggregate metrics under `results/experiments/controls/`, with summary tables in `results/experiments/controls/summary.md` and `results/experiments/controls/summary.json`.

items.description: Run the first seed-matched order-668 kill test on the canonical 64-modular frontier object.
items.acceptance_criteria: From the same canonical seed and same budget, compare H1 against `greedy`, `tabu`, `simulated annealing`, and the same-coordinate non-CA control; save raw traces under `results/experiments/order_668_64m/`; do not continue broad sweeps unless H1 shows an exact-feasibility advantage or a clearly better near-exact trajectory under equal controls.
items.notes: Ran the first matched frontier batch from `results/frontier/order_668_64m/seed_sequences.json` with shared budget `80`, restart count `3`, RNG seed `17`, and `restart_packet_flips = 2` across `H1_defect_syndrome_ca_64m`, `greedy`, `tabu`, `simulated_annealing`, and `stochastic_hillclimb`. Saved configs and raw outputs under `results/experiments/order_668_64m/`; `results/experiments/order_668_64m/summary.md` records the kill-test decision: no method reached exactness, H1 never beat the seed objective, and broad H1 sweeps stop pending verification-pack review.

items.description: Use `monitor`, `benchmark_auditor`, and `integrator` to audit runtime evidence and restart statistics.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/runtime_audit.md` confirming that logs, seeds, restart counts, wall-clock time, objective evaluations, and canonicalized outputs are complete for every reported run; missing control data invalidates the batch.
items.notes: Created `results/verification/runtime_audit.md` and `results/verification/runtime_inventory.json` after auditing all `15` control/frontier run JSONs plus one specialist round with `benchmark_auditor`, `monitor`, and `integrator`. The audit confirms complete seed paths, restart statistics, wall-clock time, objective-evaluation counts, canonical fingerprints, and non-empty traces for every reported run, with sampled-trace / `best_over_run` semantics kept explicit as a caveat rather than a missing-data defect.

items.description: Produce the specialist verification pack under `results/verification/`.
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md` all exist; each file cites concrete experiment IDs and named papers from `sources.bib`; `verification_summary.md` states continue, pivot, or stop.

items.description: Compare experimental behavior against the literature review rather than against internal baselines alone.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/analysis/prior_work_comparison.md` comparing state representation, locality, seed dependence, certification, exactness, and compute budget against at least 5 papers from `sources.bib`, including the 2025 order-668 frontier paper and at least 2 CA-adjacent or annealing-based baselines.

items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/writeup/methods_brief.md` and `results/writeup/claims_table.md`; every claim must point to a verification artifact or a BibTeX entry in `sources.bib`; the reviewer must explicitly flag any wording that overclaims exactness or novelty.

items.description: Assemble a reproducibility and decision packet for the next agent pass.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/writeup/repro.md` with exact commands, seeds, config paths, and artifact locations; ensure `results/verification/verification_summary.md` names the next action (`continue H1`, `pivot to H2`, or `stop H3`); by the end of the run, item statuses in `research_rubric.json` and the summary counts agree exactly.
